prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Home new flow changes have proven helpful, winning 2 out of 8 tests.
Sign in redesign changes have proven helpful, winning 2 out of 8 tests.
Adoption layout changes have proven helpful, winning 1 out of 3 tests.
Finish hint, home wait info, and home notification changes showed no clear effect across tests of those kinds.
Predictions were consistently too high across all round 1 tests.
Evidence is still thin for kinds of change that lack at least two agreeing tests after noise correction.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Pet adoption certificate card layout redesign: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a card layout to clearly structure pet registration details and milestone confirmation. (why: Adoption has a 69.8% conversion rate and high drop-off time. A structured card layout gives visual prominence to completing adoption.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop companion quick start new screen: Insert a new screen before home intro that demonstrates key desktop interaction actions like dragging, right-clicking, and hiding the pet. (why: 3 support tickets reported confusion after onboarding on how to control, hide, or talk to the desktop pet.)
2: [sign_in, redesign] Sign-in checklist layout redesign: Redesign the sign-in screen into a checklist layout that highlights cloud backup, pet recovery, and sync options. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again, making backup clarity essential.)
3: [home, new_flow] Desktop environment readiness new flow on waiting screen: Add an environment status verification badge and notification flow to the waiting screen while background rendering finishes. (why: 3 support emails reported pets failing to show on desktop, and the waiting step has a long median wait of 201s.)
4: [choose_path, redesign] Choose path spotlight layout redesign: Redesign the choose path screen with a spotlight layout focusing on the key choice between premade companions and custom creation. (why: Choose path has a 79.4% conversion rate and mean time of 514s, indicating initial choice indecision.)
5: [finish, redesign] Home intro two column layout redesign: Rebuild the final welcome screen into a two-column layout highlighting pet arrival on the left and desktop launch tips on the right. (why: The finish step has the lowest conversion rate at 64.8% and long mean time spent (5815s).)
6: [adoption, new_screen] Pet avatar review new screen: Add a dedicated pet visual review screen right after photo upload to verify photo rendering before confirming adoption. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failing or visual artifacts in the rendering result.)
7: [sign_in, hint] Sign-in multi device recovery hint: Add a prominent helper hint on the sign-in screen explaining that using the same account restores existing pets automatically. (why: Addresses the top support issue (8 emails) where users accidentally created new empty accounts.)
8: [finish, copy] Home intro desktop control guidance headline update: Update headline and body copy on the final welcome screen to explain how to summon, move, and hide the pet on the desktop. (why: 3 support messages stated users were confused about how to control or talk to the pet after completing setup.)
9: [home, wait_info] Waiting screen rendering step progress indicator: Enable step counter indicator on the waiting screen to show active rendering progress. (why: The waiting step has a mean duration of 2336s, leading to uncertainty during background pet generation.)
